thread:
alex (AE): quick heads-up: Sparrow wants a 10-day POC. scope = invoice extraction + support Q&A. asks: starter prompts, pass/fail metrics, data handling for uploads, and POC credits. can we align owners and timeline?

jamie (SE): i can craft a 25-row prompt inventory covering broken OCR, currencies, and split line items. need sample OCR text format and whether they expect dates normalized.

alex (AE): they'll provide OCR->txt. normalize dates to ISO preferred but acceptable if we return original span too.

morgan (ML Eng): baseline extractor prompt (strict JSON):
```
System: Return ONLY JSON with keys: vendor, invoice_date, currency, total, items[]. Include per-field confidence 0-1.
User: <OCR_TEXT>
```
and QA prompt for policies: 
```
System: Use ONLY supplied docs. If answer unknown, reply "No relevant info found." Keep <=150 chars.
User: <question>
```
These are eval-friendly.

paul (Pricing): POC credits: we can cover up to 75k tokens/day for 10 days. if they need persistent reserved capacity we'll quote separately. need SE to estimate tokens/request and peak concurrency.

jamie (SE): rough estimate: input 380 tokens, output 140 -> ~520 tokens/request. expect spikes up to 12 concurrent users. batching ok for background jobs; UI needs p50 < 400ms.

tess (Security): Sparrow requires KMS + audit logs. for POC we allow managed keys, redact PII in logs, and short retention 30 days. real-data uploads require DPA; recommend synthetic for week1 then gated real uploads. i'll draft answers for their questionnaire.

anya (CSM): proposed deliverables + owners: 1) prompt inventory CSV (jamie) due 48h, 2) eval harness + thresholds (morgan) due 72h, 3) security one-pager + questionnaire (tess) EOD, 4) credits confirmation (paul) 24h, 5) kickoff + demo plan (alex+anya) this week.

morgan (ML Eng): thresholds suggestion: vendor/total exact_match >= 90%, hallucination_rate < 3% for QA, median cost/request <= $0.025 hosted. we'll wire CI to report these.

ajay (AE): (edit) scheduling note: customer prefers afternoons PT; tentatively Thursday 2pm PT. i'll confirm after we upload prompt CSV and security one-pager.

jamie (SE): ack. i'll upload CSV + a tiny demo notebook and include expected JSON outputs. setting up fallback: regex for total/currency with a used_fallback flag.

tess (Security): ack. drafting one-pager now with KMS options and DPA language.

paul (Pricing): ack, sending credit summary + overage note.

anya (CSM): thanks team 680. closing thread after all artifacts posted to shared folder.
